===== PROBE =====
name: system.os_release
started_utc: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
root_mode: none
run_as: root
requires: /etc/os-release
timeout_s: 120
runner: timeout -k 5 120 bash -o pipefail -c <command>
===== COMMAND =====
cat /etc/os-release
===== STDOUT =====
PRETTY_NAME="Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm)"
NAME="Debian GNU/Linux"
VERSION_ID="12"
ID=debian
===== STDERR =====
===== RESULT =====
exit_code: 0
duration_s: 0.010
status: ok
note:
